original_ai_output.title_zh: 马查尔否认参与马朱尔撤离失败，并为代理领导人辩护
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹前第一副总统里克·马查尔在庭审中否认曾下令已故少将戴维·马朱尔·达克在2025年3月纳西尔战斗中投降，称自己曾努力确保其安全撤离。他还否认指挥白军，并否认与当地青年扣押170至176名纳西尔事件幸存者作为人质。马查尔与七名共同被告面临谋杀、共谋、恐怖主义、叛国等指控，检方指控SPLA-IO部队与白军联手在纳西尔杀害257名SSPDF士兵。

key_facts.fact: 马查尔否认曾下令马朱尔·达克在纳西尔战斗中投降
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former First Vice President Riek Machar has denied ordering the late Maj. Gen. David Majur Dak to surrender during fighting in Nasir in March 2025

key_facts.fact: 马查尔称曾努力确保马朱尔·达克安全撤离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he had instead tried to secure the general’s safe evacuation from the area

key_facts.fact: 马查尔否认指挥白军，并称代理主席雷吉娜·约瑟夫·卡巴也不指挥该武装青年组织
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Machar also denied commanding the White Army and said Regina Joseph Kaba... does not command the armed youth group

key_facts.fact: 马查尔否认与当地青年扣押170至176名纳西尔事件幸存者作为人质
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Machar also denied allegations that he and local youths had held between 170 and 176 survivors of the Nasir incident hostage

key_facts.fact: 马查尔与七名共同被告面临谋杀、共谋、恐怖主义、叛国等指控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Machar and seven co-defendants face charges including murder, conspiracy, terrorism, treason, destruction of public property and crimes against humanity

key_facts.fact: 检方指控SPLA-IO部队与白军联手在纳西尔杀害257名SSPDF士兵
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Prosecutors allege that SPLA-IO forces allied with the White Army killed 257 SSPDF soldiers

uncertainties: 马查尔所提指控与检方指控均为单方说法，尚未经法庭裁决
